name: Hill chicken
summary: Hill chicken is a free-range bird with firm meat, grilled over charcoal with lá mắc mật leaves until the skin is crisp.
origin: Bản Đôn, Pù Luông. Sources: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 18 Mar 2022; the Vietnam Airlines travel guide.
howToEat: Grilled over charcoal with lá mắc mật.
where: Bản Đôn and the valley meal.
seoTitle: Hill chicken in Pu Luong — grilled with la mac mat
seoDescription: Gà đồi is free-range hill chicken, firm and crisp-skinned, grilled over charcoal with lá mắc mật.
